description: VALORE-EU waste valorisation model is published by European Commission JRC; DTU. VALORE-EU compares waste valorisation options using life-cycle environmental and economic effects. Its stated coverage is European Union waste-policy scenarios. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through listed XLSX resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The full-resource cost is unknown and requires provider clarification. The licence is Non-Free Software, as stated by the JRC model inventory. The provider says the model code and input/output databases are not publicly available; its current base dataset is a hypothetical EU27 system. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
